هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص الشهرى
بأنظمة
الاطفاء 
(مياه - رغوية) المستخدمة فى سيارات الاطفاء

أعد 
المسودة الأولية المهندس/ أحمد محمد المهتدي قمرة و اختبرها المهندس/ علاء محمد 
شاهين و راجعها المهندس/ السعيد شعبان عبد القادر و وافق عليها السيد المهندس/ محمد 
صبري زيدان مدير عام شئون 
المحطة
و 
اعتمدها السيد المهندس/ أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء 
النوبارية.

راجعها و وافق على المستند المهندس 
/ مدحت محمد خاطر 
مفتش السلامة والصحة المهنية بقطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة
و وافق على المستند المهندس/ سمير عبد الجليل أحمد مدير عام التفتيش الفني 
بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء و منسق الشركة لنظام معلومات اجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد المهندس/ محمد نجيب عبد الحي رئيس قطاع التفتيش و مراقبة الجودة 
بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء.

اتباع اجراءات السلامة و الصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 و المعدات و ارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة آمان- حذاء آمان اوفرول- 
 جوانتي.......).

الإجراءات المطلوب تنفيذها
اولا : اجراءات عامة

rows: التأكد من تجربة تشغيل سيارة الاطفاء و صلاحيتها
التأكد من أن السرينة تعمل
التأكد من أن الفلاشر يعمل
ثانيا: نظام الاطفاء بالمياه

التأكد من سلامة جسم خزان المياه و التأكد من عدم وجود 
 تآكل أو ثقوب

التاكد 
 من ملء خزان المياه.
التأكد من سلامة البلوف الحاكمة وعدم وجود تهريبات.
التأكد من إعداد الخراطيم بحيث يكون عددها 20 خرطوم

التأكد 
 من سلامة مكرات التدخل السريع (يمين و شمال)

التأكد 
 من سلامة المدفع اليدوي أعلى السيارة و تحريكه في جميع الاتجاهات.

التأكد 
 من سلامة القواذف الخاصة بالمياه العادية و المتعددة الأغراض.

التأكد 
 من سلامة وصلات السحب الخاصة بملء السيارة .

التأكد 
 من وجود عدد 4 وصلات سحب و الفانوس الخاص بها.

تشغيل طلمبة طرد المياه و تجربة المدفع و مكرات التدخل السريع (يمين و شمال) و 
 بعض خراطيم الاطفاء
 و القواذف
تجربة طلمبة سحب المياه و التأكد من سلامة وصلات السحب.
إعاده النظام كسابقه والتأكد من ان منسوب المياه مثالى
ثالثا: نظام الاطفاء بالسائل الرغوي

التأكد 
 من سلامة فحص جسم خزان السائل الرغوي و التأكد من عدم وجود تآكل أو ثق

التأكد 
 من أن منسوب خزان المياه مثالي.
التأكد من سلامة البلوف الحاكمة من وجود تهريبات.
مراجعة اعداد الخراطيم بحيث يكون عددها 20 خرطوم.
التأكد من سلامة القواذف الخاصة بالرغوي.
التأكد من أن منسوب السائل الرغوي مثالي .

تشغيل طلمبة طرد المياه و تجربة تشغيل نظام الماده الرغوية وملاحظة جودة المادة 
 الرغوى

تشغيل النظام مرة آخرى بالمياه لعمل نظافة من الرغاوى للوصلات والخراطيم 
 المستخدمة .

إعاده النظام كسابقة والتأكد من ان منسوب خزان المياه 
 والرغوى فى الحدود المسموح بها

رابعا: 
 ملحقات سيارة الاطفاء
التأكد من وجود بدل مقاومة للحريق بمشتملاتها
التاكد من وجود جهاز تنفس صناعي و صلاحيته.
التأكد من وجود معدات الانقاذ (أحبال- مقص- عتلة- بلطة......)
التأكد من صلاحية السلم الخاص بسيارة الاطفاء.

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps of the monthly inspection of the fire-extinguishing systems (water – foam) used on fire trucks.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mehtadi Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Mohamed Sabri Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of the Nubaria Power Station Sector.

It was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

items: Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

sections_en.text: Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures

rows: Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
Verify that the siren is working.
Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the water tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
Verify that the water tank is full.
Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
Verify that the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
Verify that the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
Verify that the nozzles for plain water and for multi-purpose use are sound.
Verify that the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
Verify that there are 4 suction connections and the lamp provided with them.
Run the water discharge pump and test the monitor, the quick-intervention reels (right and left), some of the fire hoses and the nozzles.
Test the water suction pump and verify that the suction connections are sound.
Return the system to its previous state and verify that the water level is ideal.
Third: Foam-Liquid Fire-Extinguishing System
Verify the foam-liquid tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
Verify that the water tank level is ideal.
Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
Check the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
Verify that the foam nozzles are sound.
Verify that the foam-liquid level is ideal.
Run the water discharge pump, test-operate the foam system and observe the quality of the foam.
Run the system again with water to flush the foam from the connections and hoses used.
Return the system to its previous state and verify that the water and foam tank levels are within the permitted limits.
Fourth: Fire Truck Accessories
Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the monthly inspection of the fire-extinguishing systems (water – foam) used on fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mehtadi Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Mohamed Sabri Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of the Nubaria Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and documented by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet – safety shoes – overalls – gloves ...).

Procedures to be Carried Out — First: General Procedures
1. | Verify the fire truck's trial operation and that it is serviceable.
2. | Verify that the siren is working.
3. | Verify that the flasher is working.
Second: Water Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the water tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
2. | Verify that the water tank is full.
3. | Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
4. | Verify the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
5. | Verify that the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
6. | Verify that the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
7. | Verify that the nozzles for plain water and for multi-purpose use are sound.
8. | Verify that the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
9. | Verify that there are 4 suction connections and the lamp provided with them.
10 | Run the water discharge pump and test the monitor, the quick-intervention reels (right and left), some of the fire hoses and the nozzles.
11. | Test the water suction pump and verify that the suction connections are sound.
12. | Return the system to its previous state and verify that the water level is ideal.
Third: Foam-Liquid Fire-Extinguishing System
1. | Verify the foam-liquid tank body is sound and check for corrosion or holes.
2. | Verify that the water tank level is ideal.
3. | Verify that the control valves are sound and free of leaks.
4. | Check the number of hoses: 20 hoses.
5. | Verify that the foam nozzles are sound.
6. | Verify that the foam-liquid level is ideal.
7. | Run the water discharge pump, test-operate the foam system and observe the quality of the foam.
8. | Run the system again with water to flush the foam from the connections and hoses used.
9. | Return the system to its previous state and verify that the water and foam tank levels are within the permitted limits.
Fourth: Fire Truck Accessories
1. | Verify the presence of fire-resistant suits with their accessories.
2. | Verify the presence of a breathing apparatus and that it is serviceable.
3. | Verify the presence of rescue equipment (ropes – shears – crowbar – axe ...).
4. | Verify that the fire truck's ladder is serviceable.
